title: Investigate Windows Codex foreground interruption returning while its focused launcher remains alive
outcome: Determine and document how a foreground Codex command on Windows can be safely cancelled when sending Ctrl-C returns an exit for the execution wrapper while its focused launcher and owned command tree remain alive; identify the responsible boundary and a supported cancellation path without claiming that stdin bytes necessarily deliver a console signal.
acceptance: Investigate Windows Codex foreground interruption returning while its focused launcher remains alive is done
